items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: Very good, but he wasn't the musician. You see, Dave Payton worked at the Grand Theatre for Gibbs, and then he worked at the Regal.

ctx.x: Yes. How was Dave Payton? Was he pretty good? Very good.
Very good, but he wasn't the musician. You see, Dave Payton worked at the Grand Theatre for Gibbs, and then he worked at the Regal.
Regal, I know. That's when I knew him. I didn't know him, but I never knew him very well.
